`SnlInteractionDriver` receives hover, leave, click and Ctrl-click context, including semantic tree paths. Display layout is not identity: a repeated SVG placement must still identify the correct child. Binding hover must reach the actual binder, not merely another token with equal text.

`EntryPreviewProvider` renders recursive Entry previews from Macro source Entries through the supplied drivers. Shared hover/popover mechanisms own opening, pinning, dismissal and viewport placement. Consumers should inherit those defaults unless deliberately changing policy, rather than copying their current timing constants.

Entry title/source/preview actions are injected host callbacks. Block hover, Ctrl-hover and Ctrl-click remain distinct from nested semantic/title/button actions; a nested action must not be dispatched again as a block Ctrl-click. Ctrl pressed after entering the block must update the hover mode. Callback failures are contained by the renderer rather than tearing down the Entry.

**Acceptance requirements:** test a real semantic-node hover, a bound variable and its binder, nested preview creation, pin/dismiss behavior, Ctrl-before/after-enter, theme switching while a preview is open, and unmount cleanup. Passing only static CSS or event-handler unit tests is not evidence that an installed host behaves correctly.


## Native inline-text highlight geometry

A semantic node is the unit of identity; DOM fragment count is not frame count. In ordinary horizontal flow, draw one frame per contiguous occupied visual-line segment. Consolidate adjacent/overlapping fragments on the same original line, including nested text and repeated placeholders. Do not retain duplicate interior outlines. Disjoint segments stay separate; outside prefix/suffix prose must not enter the frame. Different prose lines remain separate rather than forming a global bounding box. Empty lines retain layout space without invented positive-area frames.

Inline formula islands may paint beyond their wrappers. Enclose their complete visible extent on the associated original layout line. Assign descendants against unexpanded anchors, using horizontal position to disambiguate same-height disjoint segments: a tall expanded formula must not absorb adjacent prose lines. Display-formula and block islands retain their atomic layout regions. Formula/block-only targets keep the existing full-subtree envelope contract.

Hover is paint-only: no inline-block conversion, border spacing, text motion, or reflow. Resize, actual-owner scroll, render updates, and unmount reconcile frame count and remove stale frames. Existing hidden zero-geometry ownership and cleanup remain compatible. Semantic paths, repeated placements, target selection, palettes and binding identity do not change.

**Acceptance:** real hover/screenshots must cover nested and repeated text, first-line-tail/last-line-head outside-content exclusion, explicit breaks/blank lines, narrow/wide resize, scrolling, cleanup, and a tall formula. Assert no same-line duplicate or overlapping frames and preserve disjoint segments; simply matching frame count to getClientRects is insufficient. Independently restoring per-DOM-fragment frames and bypassing separator break processing must fail their respective regression oracles. Rotated/vertical writing is outside this horizontal line-segment rule.
